items.title: Senior Support Specialist, Ads
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s User Operations team ensures that our customers’ experience is nothing short of exceptional. We resolve complex issues, provide guidance, and support customers in maximizing value with our products. Within User Operations, Ads Safety Operations helps OpenAI grow advertising in a way that is safe, trusted, and sustainable for advertisers, users and the business. The Ads Safety Support team sits within Ads Safety Operations and owns the advertiser-facing support journey: helping advertisers navigate ads products, policies, reviews, and enforcement decisions while turning frontline insights into better guidance, tooling, and product experiences. About the Role We’re looking for a Senior Advertiser Support Specialist to help build and scale advertiser support within Ads Safety Operations. You’ll work directly with advertisers through support tickets, escalations, owning high-impact questions related to ads policies, review outcomes, product behavior, and operational processes. Many cases will be novel or ambiguous, and you’ll be expected to investigate carefully, communicate clearly, and drive them to resolution in a fast-moving product environment. As OpenAI’s advertising ecosystem grows, your work will help advertisers operate successfully at scale while serving as a critical bridge between frontline support and the teams responsible for product quality, policy integrity, and platform safety. Beyond resolving individual cases, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AI-native environment. You’ll turn support interactions into operational intelligence, identifying recurring friction, gaps in guidance, and emerging issues to improve support at scale, and protect the quality and safety of OpenAI’s ad ecosystem. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, Policy, Legal and Go To Market partners to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale. In this role, you will: - Own advertiser cases from initial intake through resolution, including complex or sensitive Ads Trust & Safety escalations; investigate whether issues stem from policy, review operations, product behavior, tooling, or another dependency, then communicate clear next steps and follow through. - Develop deep expertise across advertiser workflows, ads policies, enforcement processes, review systems, and support tooling. - Build a detailed view of advertiser friction by combining ticket themes, escalation patterns, quality findings, and service metrics to prioritize improvements and identify emerging experience or safety gaps. - Turn frontline learnings into clearer help content, stronger playbooks, better routing and escalation criteria, improved knowledge management and quality standards, and self-service opportunities. - Partner with Product, Policy, Engineering, Legal, Data Science, and Go To Market teams to resolve recurring issues, surface advertiser feedback, and scale durable solutions. - Drive operational excellence through AI-assisted workflows and automation that reduce manual effort, improve team efficiency, and elevate support quality. - Support readiness for new ads formats, features, and markets by anticipating advertiser questions and identifying support risks early. - Providing occasional holiday and weekend support on call coverage, as needed, to support business and customer needs. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 6+ years of experience in customer support, user operations, ads operations, Trust & Safety, risk operations, escalations, or a related field, including ownership of high-impact customer or advertiser cases. - Bring strong investigative judgment and can translate ambiguous signals into policy support, operational gaps, product defects, and expected behavior - Can synthesize data trends, feedback, QA findings, and service metrics into clear priorities and system improvement while maintaining strong judgment and safeguards - Have improved support processes, knowledge bases, escalation workflows, routing systems, or quality programs. - Are comfortable using AI and emerging technologies (i.e. Codex, ChatGPT, OpenAI API, etc.) and/or code (e.g. Python) to automate repetitive tasks and integrating tools - Build trust with cross-functional partners, communicate clearly and empathetically with advertisers and internal teams, and drive action without formal authority. - Thrive in ambiguity, learn quickly, manage competing priorities, and bring a humble, service-oriented mindset. - Bonus: Understand advertiser workflows, ads ecosystems, policy enforcement, account reviews, or ads safety operations. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

items.title: Software Engineer, Financial Engineering
items.description: About the team OpenAI’s Applied AI organization turns our latest model capabilities into products used by hundreds of millions of consumers, developers, and organizations worldwide. Our teams build the product experiences and platform foundations behind ChatGPT, Codex, our API platform, and offerings for businesses, enterprises, educational institutions, and other customers. Financial Engineering powers how customers purchase, access, and pay for these products. We build the systems behind pricing and packaging, checkout, payments, subscriptions, usage-based billing, credits, entitlements, invoicing, and the broader order-to-cash lifecycle. Our work spans consumer subscriptions, self-serve businesses, sophisticated enterprise agreements, developer usage, and emerging monetization models. These systems sit at the intersection of product experience and financial infrastructure. They must make it easy for customers to adopt OpenAI products while maintaining strong guarantees around correctness, reliability, security, reconciliation, and auditability. We partner closely with Product, Data Science, Finance, Accounting, Risk, Operations, and Go-to-Market teams to launch new offerings and build a financial platform that can evolve with OpenAI’s rapidly growing product portfolio. We are looking for an experienced engineer to help architect and build the next generation of these systems. In this role, you will: - Have 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend, platform, or distributed systems. - Have strong fundamentals in API design, data modeling, storage systems, transactional workflows, and event-driven architecture. - Have experience building systems where correctness, reliability, observability, security, or data integrity are especially important. - Are comfortable owning ambiguous, business-critical problems from initial definition through launch and long-term operation. - Bring a product-oriented mindset and care about creating simple, trustworthy experiences for both external customers and internal users. - Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners and enjoy working closely with Product, Finance, Accounting, Operations, Data, and Go-to-Market teams. - Make thoughtful tradeoffs between near-term delivery and long-term system quality. - Move quickly and independently in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities compete, and the right solution is not always obvious. Nice to Have: - Experience with payments, subscriptions, billing, pricing, credits, entitlements, invoicing, revenue systems, or other monetization infrastructure. - Experience with high-scale financial or transactional systems, reconciliation workflows, compliance requirements, or audit controls. - Experience building shared platforms, APIs, frameworks, or developer tools used by multiple product teams. items.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Services
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE The exchange is the core of what Polymarket does. Every trade, every order, every market resolution runs through the systems this team owns. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Services team, you'll be working directly on that infrastructure, building and scaling the backend that processes real money, in real time, at meaningful volume. The work is technical, high-stakes, and unambiguous in its consequences. This is an individual contributor role with high autonomy and high ownership. You'll work alongside a small group of senior engineers who care deeply about correctness and performance. There's no heavy process here, no committees, no long approval chains. You'll be expected to identify problems, propose solutions, and ship them. The mandate is simple: keep the exchange fast, correct, and available as Polymarket continues to scale. If you've spent your career building systems where performance actually matters, where a bug in production has real consequences, this is the kind of problem you've been waiting to work on. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design and implement low-latency backend services that power Polymarket's core exchange, primarily in Go, with Python or Java where appropriate. - Profile and tune systems across the full stack, identifying bottlenecks in latency, throughput, and memory usage before they become production problems. - Build and maintain event-driven data pipelines and APIs using streaming platforms like Kafka or Pulsar, ensuring data moves reliably and quickly across the exchange. - Own production reliability for the systems you build, including diagnosing live incidents, writing postmortems, and shipping fixes that prevent recurrence. - Work directly with engineers across product, infrastructure, and data to integrate exchange services tightly with the broader platform. - Contribute to architectural decisions on distributed systems design, with a focus on failure modes, graceful degradation, and recovery under partial outages. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 4 to 7+ years of professional backend development experience, with strong proficiency in Go, Python, or Java. Go experience is a significant advantage. - Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and memory management, with a track record of applying that knowledge to real production systems. - Experience building and debugging high-throughput, low-latency systems on Linux end-to-end, from design through to production operation. - Strong instincts for correctness, especially in systems where failures have financial consequences. You write defensively, think about edge cases early, and treat bugs in prod as a serious matter. - Comfortable working independently in a high-autonomy environment. You identify what needs to be done and do it without waiting to be unblocked. - (Plus) Experience in trading systems, high-frequency trading, gaming, telecom, or any domain where latency is a hard constraint, not a stretch goal. - (Plus) Production experience with Kafka, Pulsar, or similar streaming platforms at meaningful scale. - (Plus) Familiarity with gRPC, Protobuf, or ZeroMQ. - (Plus) Experience deploying and operating services in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, using containers and modern deployment tooling. BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $250,000 to $500,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

items.title: Trust & Safety Ads Operations Analyst, Data
items.description: About the Team At OpenAI, Trust & Safety Operations is central to protecting OpenAI’s platform, customers, and the public from abuse. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Policy and Go To Market teams to identify emerging risks, build and mature enforcement systems, and ensure high-integrity operations while delivering a great user experience at scale. We’re building the Monetization Trust & Safety Operations team to ensure OpenAI can grow advertising in a way that is safe, trusted, and sustainable—for users, advertisers, and the business. This team sits at the intersection of operational scale, product risk, and rapid revenue growth, designing systems and operations that enable ads to scale without compromising user trust or safety. It’s critical to us that our Ads product be built in a way that corresponds to our Ads principles https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fopenai%2Ecom%2Findex%2Four-approach-to-advertising-and-expanding-access%2F&urlhash=tnG4&isSdui=true, and this team is key to that. About the Role We’re looking for a senior operator with strong analytical instincts to help build and scale Monetization Trust & Safety Operations at OpenAI. In this role, you’ll flex across the team’s highest-priority data and operational needs—from reporting and dashboard insights to budget and capacity planning, project-based analysis, and data automation —while partnering closely with Product, Policy, Engineering, Legal, Go To Market, and Data Science and Data Engineering teams. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and data: you’ll define ambiguous problems, query and validate data, build decision-support systems, and translate operational signals into clear recommendations and scalable, AI-first solutions. You should be comfortable moving from a high-level question to a rigorous analysis, a useful dashboard, an automated workflow, or a durable operating mechanism. As OpenAI introduces new revenue-generating formats and partnerships, you’ll help the team understand where risks, capacity constraints, quality gaps, and opportunities are emerging. You’ll bring structure to ambiguity and ensure Ads Trust & Safety decisions are grounded in reliable data while balancing user safety, advertiser experience, and business growth. In this role, you will: - Own complex, high-impact Ads Trust & Safety data and operational problem areas from scoping through execution. - Improve recurring reporting and dashboards by defining meaningful metrics, surfacing trends and gaps, and translating insights into operational decisions. - Lead budget and capacity planning by connecting demand, review volumes, service levels, quality, and risk signals to staffing and operating plans. - Conduct project-based analyses across advertiser risk, enforcement performance, review quality, product launches, and operational health; turn findings into clear recommendations and next steps. - Partner closely with Data Science and Data Engineering teams to define goals, metric logic, data requirements, source-of-truth decisions, and QA data strategy. - Design and maintain practical data-quality and measurement mechanisms, including sampling, validation, discrepancy investigation, quality dashboards, and feedback loops. - Build and improve automations, AI-assisted workflows, and decision-support tools that reduce manual work and help Ads Trust & Safety and Ads Support scale. - Drive operational readiness for new Ads and monetization launches, features, and markets by sizing impact, identifying risks early, and defining monitoring plans. - Act as a senior cross-functional partner and subject-matter expert, communicating data-driven tradeoffs, priorities, and recommendations with strong judgment and credibility. You might thrive in this role if you: - 8+ years of experience in Trust & Safety, Business Integrity, technical operations, data analytics, or a closely related domain. - Strong SQL skills and comfort working with unfamiliar, complex datasets, reconciling source-of-truth questions, and resolving data-quality issues. - Experience building and owning dashboards, recurring reporting, monitoring, or operational measurement systems from scoping through adoption and maintenance. - Experience using data for budget, capacity, or workforce planning, including translating demand, quality, and service-level signals into practical operating plans. - Proven ability to independently own ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives and turn analysis into decisions, workflows, or scalable systems. - In-depth experience leveraging AI models or agent-based tooling in operational workflows, or other lightweight technical development where useful. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analyses, data limitations, risk tradeoffs, and recommendations to diverse audiences. - Strong judgment around quality, safeguards, responsible deployment, and the appropriate use of data in high-stakes operational decisions. - Bonus: Familiarity with ads and advertiser ecosystems and the operational signals that shape review, enforcement, and support decisions. items.title: Product Marketing Manager, Advertising & Engagement
items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com About this role - Product Marketing Manager, Advertising & Engagement Genius Sports is evolving from a technology and services business into a more product-led organization. Within Advertising & Engagement, that means helping the market understand the breadth and value of our advertising portfolio — from official live data and fan identity to real-time activation products like Genius Sports Moments. This is one of the fastest-moving parts of our business: our Moment Engine now integrates with partners representing roughly 90% of the programmatic advertising ecosystem, and adoption is accelerating around tentpole moments like the Super Bowl, the NBA Finals and the FIFA World Cup. We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager, Advertising & Engagement to help shape, launch and grow our advertising technology portfolio. This is a high-impact role within one of Genius Sports' most strategically important and fastest-growing business areas, working closely with Product, Marketing, Commercial and Revenue teams to bring complex advertising products to market in a clear, compelling and commercially effective way. This role is ideal for a B2B product marketer who enjoys turning complex technology into sharp positioning, clear sales narratives and practical go-to-market plans. You will support the Advertising & Engagement marketing leadership while owning important workstreams across product launches, sales enablement, customer insight, product adoption and market positioning. You will play a central role in helping Genius Sports tell a stronger Advertising & Engagement story: not just as a trusted provider of official sports data, but as the execution layer connecting live sports data directly to real-time advertising activation — helping brands, agencies, broadcasters and platforms move from scheduled campaigns to always-on, moment-driven advertising. Responsibilities Product positioning and messaging Develop clear, differentiated positioning and messaging for Genius Sports' Advertising & Engagement products, translating technical capabilities into customer-centric value propositions. Build messaging frameworks that help Product, Commercial and Marketing teams consistently explain what our products do, who they are for, why they matter and how they compare in market. Help sharpen Genius Sports' advertising narrative around real-time activation, official data, fan identity and AI-powered decisioning — shifting the category conversation from scheduled media to moment-driven engagement. Go-to-market planning and product launches Own and support GTM plans for key Advertising & Engagement product launches, releases and strategic packages, including new capabilities, integrations and partnerships. Work with Product, Commercial and Marketing teams to define target audiences, customer pain points, launch objectives, timelines, KPIs, sales motions, collateral needs and campaign requirements. Sequence launches and campaigns against the global sports calendar, supporting major product and market moments including tentpole events like the Super Bowl, NBA Finals and FIFA World Cup, new season activity, and flagship industry events such as NewFronts. Sales enablement and commercial support Create foundational sales enablement materials that help Commercial teams confidently sell complex advertising and engagement products. Work with our Sales Marketing team to build sales decks, one-pagers, battlecards, product narratives, FAQs, internal briefings and training materials for audiences including brands, agencies, broadcasters, SSPs and demand platforms. Run product training and enablement sessions for Commercial teams, ensuring sales teams understand new products, releases, positioning and proof points. Partner with Commercial stakeholders to understand barriers to adoption or deal progression, then create tools and messaging that help overcome them. Customer insight and market understanding Build a strong understanding of advertisers, agencies, broadcasters, programmatic platforms, market trends and the competitive landscape across sports adtech. Conduct and synthesize customer interviews, sales feedback, surveys and market research to inform product positioning, messaging and GTM strategy. Act as a customer and market voice within the Marketing team, helping ensure campaigns and collateral reflect real advertiser and agency needs and buying drivers. Product adoption and release communication Improve how new Advertising & Engagement products, features and releases are communicated internally and externally. Work with Product and Commercial teams to ensure important product updates, including expanding Moment Engine integrations, are understood, adopted and commercialized effectively. Support stronger customer education and product utilization by creating clearer communications, launch materials and adoption-focused messaging. Product expertise and cross-functional influence Develop a deep understanding of Genius Sports' Advertising & Engagement portfolio, where products create value, how they are sold, and how they compare to competitors. Build strong relationships across Product, Marketing, Commercial, Revenue, Data and Partnerships teams. Contribute upstream in the product development process by helping shape target audiences, value propositions, product packaging, naming, messaging, and launch readiness. Evidence, reporting and thought leadership Help build a stronger repository of case studies, customer proof points, product performance stories, and launch reports — including brand recall and campaign performance evidence from real-time activation. Work with Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to identify customer success stories and turn them into compelling collateral, campaign content and thought leadership. Support post-launch and post-event reporting to show product impact, customer adoption, and commercial value. Qualifications 3–5 years' experience in B2B product marketing, product-led marketing, commercial marketing, or a related role. Experience working in adtech, martech, programmatic advertising, media, fan engagement or sports technology. A strong storyteller who can simplify complex products and turn technical detail into clear, commercially compelling messaging. Experience developing product positioning, value propositions, launch plans, sales collateral and enablement materials. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to present to internal teams and act as a product evangelist. Commercially minded, with an understanding of how marketing supports revenue, product adoption, and customer growth. Comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Marketing and Revenue teams. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple workstreams across launches, campaigns, and stakeholder groups. Curious, proactive, and comfortable getting into the detail of technical products, customer needs and market dynamics. The annualized base salary for this role ranges from $120,000 to $160,000 USD and includes eligibility for additional variable compensation and equity. This role will also be eligible to take part in Genius Sports Group's benefits plan. We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. Occasional travel may be required. As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Sports. Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

items.title: Reseller Enablement Lead
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the team Within GTM, the Partner Enablement team builds the programs, credentials, and learning infrastructure that allow Anthropic's ecosystem of system integrators, cloud providers, resellers, and technology partners to build deep Claude expertise and deliver successful customer outcomes at scale. We work cross-functionally across Partnerships, Sales, Applied AI, Product, Marketing, and Legal to make sure partner-facing programs are clear, consistent, and high-impact. About the role Anthropic is launching a global reseller program, and we are looking for a Reseller Enablement Lead to build the enablement motion that makes it work. You will design and launch reseller certification, training, and readiness programs alongside the program itself, starting in our first launch markets and scaling globally from there. This is a build-and-run role. In the first months you will stand up the foundation from scratch: what a reseller needs to know to sell Claude well, how we certify that they know it, and how we deliver that across markets and languages. From there, you will own the motion as it grows, evolving content and modalities as the program's commercial structure matures, localizing for new regions, and using enablement to keep partner behavior aligned with how we want Claude sold. You will be the single global owner for reseller enablement, scaling delivery through training networks rather than a large direct team. This is a highly cross-functional role working closely with Partnerships, Partner Programs, Partner Operations, Sales, Applied AI, and Certification to ensure reseller-facing programs land clearly and drive measurable outcomes. Responsibilities Define and own Anthropic's reseller enablement strategy, from launch in initial markets through global rollout Own delivery of the message you build: present and deliver training directly to reseller sellers and leaders, and activate training partners so they carry it consistently at scale Build the reseller curriculum and certification path from the ground up, covering commercial mechanics, program rules, platform and product fundamentals, and responsible use Design repeatable programs across partner onboarding, sales readiness, recertification, and product launches, choosing modalities that fit how reseller sellers actually learn and what motivates them Stand up localized delivery in launch markets, then extend the model to new regions through training networks and regional enablement teams Work closely with Applied AI to translate technical concepts into clear, digestible content on Anthropic's models and products for a seller audience Evolve enablement as the program evolves, keeping content current with changes to commercial structure, transaction rails, and program requirements Use enablement as a governance lever, building content and reinforcement that keeps partner selling behavior on program and addresses drift when it appears Enable Anthropic sellers and partner managers to co-sell and engage effectively with resellers Partner cross-functionally with Partner Programs, Partner Operations, and Sales to align priorities and ensure consistent execution Establish metrics and reporting to track reseller certification, activation, and contribution to registered pipeline and consumption Build feedback loops that bring reseller insights back into program design, enablement, and GTM strategy You may be a good fit if you Have 7-10+ years of experience across partner enablement, partner programs, product marketing, with a clear track record of designing and owning programs end to end. Channel and Alliances experience is key, but must be accompanied with demonstrated program ownership. Understand how resell and channel ecosystems work commercially, including deal registration, margin and rebate structures, partner tiering, and cloud marketplace motions Have built and scaled partner enablement or certification programs from nothing to something in a high-growth technology environment Think operationally and in systems, designing for scale across regions and languages rather than one-off efforts Understand how to package enablement: which modality fits which audience, what motivates partner sellers, and how to structure a curriculum that produces real selling capability Are a strong presenter and facilitator, able to deliver training credibly to partner audiences and equip others to deliver it the same way Combine leadership and hands-on execution, equally comfortable setting strategy with executives and building the first version of a course yourself Bring executive presence with partner and internal leadership, and the scrappiness to get things done in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment Are an effective cross-functional operator who can drive alignment across complex organizations Strong candidates may also have Experience launching programs in a single region and then scaling them globally, including localization and in-market delivery Experience building or running an authorized training partner or certified instructor network Prior ownership of, or close partnership with, a technology certification program Experience with resell motions in Japan, Korea, or other reseller-led markets A track record connecting enablement activity to pipeline and revenue outcomes Logistics This role is based in London. We operate a hybrid model and expect regular time onsite with partners and at Anthropic offices. Expect roughly 30-35% travel, concentrated around launch windows and launch regions. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £160,000 — £215,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Manager, Senior Support Engineering
items.description: About the Team The Senior Support Engineering team is responsible for ensuring that developers and enterprises can reliably build mission critical solutions using OpenAI models. We provide technical guidance, resolve complex issues and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our highly-capable models. We work closely with Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. We think from an automation-first mindset and leverage the latest in AI to scale our support operations. Join the Senior Support Engineering (SSE) team at OpenAI and help shape the future of Technical Support in the age of AI. About the Role We’re looking for a Support Engineering Manager to build and guide a high-performing team of experienced Senior Support Engineers with backgrounds in software engineering, site reliability engineering, and systems architecture. These engineers are trusted to operate with autonomy, tackle deeply technical challenges, and serve as the final escalation point before Engineering. In this role, you'll lead a team focused on deep problem-solving, proactive reliability work, and customer-specific troubleshooting. You’ll drive the design and operations of OpenAI’s incident management processes, including tooling, automations, and training, and ensure they are scalable and resilient. You’ll also oversee strategic customer workload monitoring, alerting, and a 24x7 rotation to ensure high-priority issues are caught early and handled with urgency. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Technical Success, and field teams to improve the supportability of our products, reduce operational burden, and shape the future of AI-driven technical support. Your team will own incident response playbooks, build internal automations, and serve as technical stewards for our most strategic accounts. This is an opportunity to define what world-class technical support looks like in the era of AGI. We're looking for a leader who combines strong technical depth with operational rigor, a passion for team development, and an automation-first mindset. The ideal candidate will have a combination of technical capabilities mixed with strong leadership and systems building strength. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Build and lead a team of deeply technical and tenured Senior Support Engineers who bring backgrounds in software engineering, site reliability engineering, and systems architecture and are experts in diagnosing and solving complex issues on OpenAI’s technologies. - Own the continuous improvement of our incident management processes, including tooling, automation, and team readiness. - Lead strategic workload health monitoring and alerting programs for key enterprise customers, ensuring effective 24x7 operational coverage. - Guide the team in designing and implementing automation and internal tools with an AI-first mindset to scale support operations efficiently. - Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, and Go-To-Market teams to escalate, resolve, and prevent high-impact technical issues. - Represent Support Engineering in customer conversations and internal forums, driving clarity and alignment on issue resolution and reliability expectations. - Shape support operations at scale by contributing to hiring plans and global shift coverage as we expand. - Play an active role in the broader Support leadership team, contributing to strategy, operations, and culture beyond your immediate team. You might thrive in this role if you: - 10+ years of experience in technical support engineering, software engineering, site reliability engineering, or a related technical discipline, including hands-on experience supporting production systems at scale. - 5+ years of experience managing engineers or leading complex, multi-person technical projects, with clear ownership over delivery, execution, and outcomes. - Bring deep technical experience in application development or infrastructure, paired with a strong instinct for operational systems and customer reliability. - Are a strong cross-functional partner with a proven ability to influence engineering and product roadmaps through support-driven insights. - Take an automation-first approach and have a track record of implementing tooling or processes that scale support impact through AI and systems thinking. - Thrive in ambiguous environments and balance strategic leadership with a willingness to get into technical details when needed. - Are energized by customer impact and excel at building trust with strategic accounts during critical issues or periods of transformation. - Are mission-driven, collaborative, and operate with high integrity and humility. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.title: Account Director, Government
items.description: About the team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. OpenAI for Government (OAI4G) helps public-sector institutions understand, adopt, and deploy highly capable AI products in support of their missions. The team brings together Sales, Solutions, Partnerships, Technical Success, Legal, Security, Policy, Global Affairs, and other cross-functional partners to help governments use AI responsibly and effectively. As part of OAI4G’s International Public Sector team, you will help public institutions in Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) and APAC translate frontier AI into secure, compliant, mission-aligned outcomes. We work across varied procurement, regulatory, security, sovereignty, and commercial environments, while maintaining a consistent commitment to safety, reliability, and public benefit. About the role We are seeking a senior Account Director (AD) to lead OpenAI’s public-sector work across ANZ, with a wider remit to develop selected priority opportunities across APAC. ANZ will be the centre of gravity for the role: you will build trusted relationships with government leaders, develop and execute account strategies, create and close complex opportunities, and help customers move from initial interest to successful adoption. This is a full-cycle, highly cross-functional sales role that combines technical understanding, strategic vision, partnership management, and value-driven execution. You will work with senior government, operational, technical, procurement, policy, and security stakeholders to identify high-impact AI use cases and translate them into credible commercial and deployment pathways across the OpenAI Platform API and Codex and ChatGPT Enterprise. You will also be an accountable customer leader after signature, working alongside specialist delivery and technical teams to keep customer outcomes, milestones, adoption, risks, and executive alignment on track. The role requires excellent judgement, executive presence, local fluency, and the ability to move between strategy, discovery, capture, procurement, delivery governance, and relationship management without day-to-day direction. This role can be based in Sydney (Hybrid model, 3 days in office) or remotely from Canberra. In this role, you will - Own a focused portfolio of ANZ public-sector accounts, while developing selected priority opportunities in APAC in line with OAI4G’s international strategy. - Build and execute comprehensive account plans that map mission priorities, stakeholders, procurement paths, partners, use cases, risks, and long-term expansion opportunities. - Drive complex opportunities through the full sales cycle, from pipeline generation, discovery, qualification, capture, and commercial strategy through negotiation, closure, adoption, and expansion. - Lead public-sector customers through their AI adoption journey, helping them identify responsible, high-impact use cases and connect mission outcomes to OpenAI’s capabilities and limitations. - Translate between government leaders, end users, technical teams, policy and security stakeholders, and internal product and engineering partners, clearly communicating requirements, progress, risks, and dependencies. - Serve as the accountable customer lead for engagements tied to clear outcomes, customer milestones, adoption measures, and commercial commitments, coordinating closely with technical specialists. - Work closely with the Partnerships team, global and regional system integrators, cloud and technology providers, local delivery partners, resellers, and strategic international partners to shape joint pursuits, deployment models, and purchasing paths. - Develop capture strategies, competitive positioning, win themes, teaming decisions, and proposal narratives that reflect ANZ and relevant APAC market conditions. - Navigate public-sector procurement, tendering, security, data-residency, compliance, and sovereignty requirements, bringing Legal, Security, Policy, Global Affairs, Finance, and other partners into opportunities early. - Build trusted relationships with senior government executives and decision-makers, while staying close to operational users and technical stakeholders whose workflows determine successful adoption. - Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, account records, customer follow-up, and executive reporting, with disciplined follow-through across markets and time zones. - Monitor the government, technology, procurement, partner, and competitive landscape across ANZ and priority APAC markets, surfacing insights that inform product roadmaps and go-to-market strategy. - Represent OpenAI at government, partner, and industry forums, strengthening networks and identifying opportunities that advance responsible public-sector adoption of AI. We’re seeking someone with experience including - 10+ years in government, public-sector technology sales, business development, consulting, transformation, systems integration, or a closely related field, with meaningful ownership of complex customer outcomes. - Direct government experience or very significant experience working with government customers, ideally including sensitive agencies, national-security-adjacent environments, regulated missions, or high-consequence operational workflows. - A current Australian Government security clearance, with the ability to maintain the clearance required for the role. - Designing and executing complex deal strategies, including opportunity shaping before formal procurement, multi-stakeholder qualification, proposal development, negotiations, and closure. - Working directly with senior public-sector executives and decision-makers, alongside technical, operational, procurement, policy, and security stakeholders. - Navigating Australia’s public-sector procurement, contracting, security, privacy, data-residency, and compliance requirements; familiarity with New Zealand and/or other APAC public-sector environments is valuable. - Selling or delivering enterprise SaaS, cloud, AI/ML, data platforms, cybersecurity, API-based products, or other complex technology solutions in highly regulated environments. - Communicating technical, commercial, and strategic concepts clearly to both executive and working-level audiences, including the ability to explain where AI is and is not an appropriate fit. - Collaborating across Sales, Solutions, Partnerships, Research, Engineering, Technical Success, Legal, Security, Policy, Global Affairs, Finance, and Operations to move complex opportunities forward. - Operating with high ownership and sound judgement in ambiguous, fast-changing environments, while managing competing priorities across countries and time zones. - Travelling regularly within ANZ, and periodically across APAC, to work on-site with customers and partners. Nice to have - Deep relationships across Australian Commonwealth, state and territory, defence, national security, or other sensitive public-sector communities. - Experience building or working through local system-integrator, reseller, cloud-provider, or strategic-partner ecosystems. - Experience leading AI, digital, technology, or business-transformation initiatives from use-case shaping through deployment and adoption. - Familiarity with public-sector AI governance, responsible AI, cybersecurity, data sovereignty, and assurance requirements. - Experience developing opportunities across more than one APAC market and adapting to different political, cultural, regulatory, and procurement contexts. - Engineering, technical, policy, or operational experience that helps you translate complex AI capabilities into credible public-sector outcomes. You will thrive in this role if you - Are customer-centric. You work to understand public institutions’ missions and constraints deeply, and help them achieve meaningful outcomes with AI. - Are a strategist. You think years ahead, balance ANZ priorities with a broader APAC perspective, and align internal and external stakeholders around a clear point of view. - Are a builder. You create repeatable account, partner, capture, and delivery practices that can scale while adapting to local requirements. - Have strong judgement. You can navigate sensitive environments, incomplete information, competing priorities, and responsible-use considerations with integrity and composure. - Are technically curious. You can learn quickly, engage credibly with specialists, and translate frontier AI capabilities, limitations, and trade-offs for government audiences. - Care about public mission impact. You want to help governments use AI responsibly and effectively in ways that improve outcomes for the communities they serve. items.title: Senior Internal Communications Manager, People
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . Coinbase is looking for a strategic, motivated communications leader to serve as the Internal Communications partner for our People Success team. With a new Chief People Officer building the next chapter of our people strategy, this role will shape how that vision reaches every employee through clear, well-timed, and compelling communications. What you’ll do: Serve as dedicated Internal Communications partner to the People Success team, owning communications strategy for People programs and company-wide rollouts with a business-first, product marketing orientation. Advise the CPO and senior People leaders on high-stakes moments, including org changes, policy shifts, leadership transitions, and other high-stakes announcements, crafting messaging that is clear, human, and builds trust Own internal communications for the People Success Team itself, including monthly town halls, leadership communications, and other resources that build team awareness, alignment, and culture. Write and edit range of content, including CPO comms, town hall scripts, company announcements, and FAQs, translating People programming into clear value propositions for Coinbase leaders and employees. Build scalable communications infrastructure, including editorial calendars, playbooks, measurement frameworks, and rhythms that support a growing People organization. Coordinate with broader Internal Communications team and cross-functional partners to ensure People messaging is well-timed and aligned with the company narrative. Build mature communications infrastructure and use data, employee insights, and AI-enabled workflows to measure impact, scale work, and continuously improve Required Skills and Experience: 10+ years in internal communications, strategic communications, change communications, or product marketing, with proven experience advising C-suite or VP-level leaders on complex, high-stakes messaging. Proven track record producing executive-level content that drove measurable engagement or adoption outcomes, with strong writing, editing, and narrative development skills. Executive presence and interpersonal effectiveness, with the confidence to push back, influence decisions, and build trust quickly with senior leaders. Demonstrated ability to manage a broad portfolio of concurrent initiatives across multiple senior stakeholders while maintaining a coordinated, clear communications strategy. Experience building scalable communications processes, systems, and measurement frameworks from scratch. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Marketing team helps deeply understand customer audiences and market dynamics, influence the development of the right products, build sustainable and customer-aligned monetization models, and drive awareness, adoption, and usage across OpenAI’s products and platform. We take a data-driven approach to understand markets, develop monetization strategies, and uncover customer needs that shape product strategy and messaging. We partner closely with Sales, Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Research, Comms, and Design to deliver a cohesive end-to-end customer experience and lead go-to-market efforts for new product launches across channels. About the Role We’re looking for a Marketing Scientist to join OpenAI’s Ads Marketing Science function. Reporting to Marketing Science leadership, you’ll be a senior individual contributor who combines rigorous measurement expertise with strong client judgment and hands-on execution. Your mission is to help OpenAI Ads prove and improve advertisers’ media performance. You’ll work with sales, partners, and clients supporting all forms of measurement including verification, attribution, incrementality, brand, marketing mix modeling (MMM), and scalable advertiser reporting, connecting sound methodology to decisions advertisers can act on. You will partner closely with Sales on key advertising accounts and with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Partnerships, Legal, and Privacy. Initial priorities include advancing incrementality measurement, helping onboard measurement partners to privacy-forward measurement workflows and integrations, and creating reusable programs, tools, agents, skills, and workflows that let sales and clients access high-quality Marketing Science support at scale. This role is based in either San Francisco or New York, and follows a hybrid schedule (Monday-Wednesday). In this role, you will: - Partner with Sales, advertisers, and agencies to shape learning agendas, interpret results, and improve media performance. - Apply rigorous advertising measurement approaches across attribution, incrementality, marketing mix modeling, and other relevant methodologies. - Develop scalable measurement programs and guidance that improve decisions and adoption of rigorous measurement practices. - Shape advertiser-facing insights experiences that translate campaign and audience data into actionable performance recommendations. - Conduct auction optimization analyses to identify delivery, pricing, and performance opportunities that improve advertiser outcomes. - Communicate complex concepts clearly and uphold high standards for privacy, quality, transparency, and responsible interpretation. items.title: Applied AI Architect, Strategic Enterprise Tech
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role: As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability. You will focus on a short list of strategic accounts within our Enterprise Technology business. For each one you will co-own the account plan with the account executive, build executive technical champions, and drive a multi-quarter adoption roadmap. You will have breadth and depth, reproducing customer environments and problems, building working solutions with them, and develop deep relationships with our engineering and product teams, all in service of each account's strategic roadmap Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems. Responsibilities: Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success Work with your customers on their overall AI adoption strategies, including use case scoping, architecture reviews, technical champion building, adoption workshops, and use case execution Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Enterprise Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives Reproduce customer environments and problems in your own builds. Use them to prove the path to production Build deep relationships with Anthropic engineering and product teams. Carry customer needs into the product roadmap and bring product direction back to your accounts Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams Travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns You may be a good fit if you have: 8+ years of experience in roles such as Field CTO, Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Product Manager, with hands-on building experience Experience working with enterprise customers, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders Experience owning named or strategic enterprise accounts through long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems Comfortable with python Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. items.title: Senior Support Specialist, Ads
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s User Operations team ensures that our customers' experience is nothing short of exceptional. We resolve complex issues, provide guidance, and support customers in maximizing value with our products. Within User Operations, Ads Safety Operations helps OpenAI grow advertising in a way that is safe, trusted, and sustainable for advertisers, users and the business. The Ads Safety Support team sits within Ads Safety Operations and owns the advertiser-facing support journey: helping advertisers navigate ads products, policies, reviews, and enforcement decisions while turning frontline insights into better guidance, tooling, and product experiences. About the Role We’re looking for an Advertiser Support Specialist to help build and scale advertiser support within Ads Safety Operations. You’ll work directly with advertisers through support tickets, escalations, owning high-impact questions related to ads policies, review outcomes, product behavior, and operational processes. Many cases will be novel or ambiguous, and you’ll be expected to investigate carefully, communicate clearly, and drive them to resolution in a fast-moving product environment. As OpenAI’s advertising ecosystem grows, your work will help advertisers operate successfully at scale while serving as a critical bridge between frontline support and the teams responsible for product quality, policy integrity, and platform safety. Beyond resolving individual cases, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AI-native environment. You’ll turn support interactions into operational intelligence, identifying recurring friction, gaps in guidance, and emerging issues to improve support at scale, and protect the quality and safety of OpenAI’s ad ecosystem. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, Policy, Legal and Go To Market partners to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale. In this role, you will: - Own advertiser cases from initial intake through resolution, including complex or sensitive Ads Trust & Safety escalations; investigate whether issues stem from policy, review operations, product behavior, tooling, or another dependency, then communicate clear next steps and follow through. - Develop deep expertise across advertiser workflows, ads policies, enforcement processes, review systems, and support tooling. - Build a detailed view of advertiser friction by combining ticket themes, escalation patterns, quality findings, and service metrics to prioritize improvements and identify emerging experience or safety gaps. - Turn frontline learnings into clearer help content, stronger playbooks, better routing and escalation criteria, improved knowledge management and quality standards, and self-service opportunities. - Partner with Product, Policy, Engineering, Legal, Data Science, and Go To Market teams to resolve recurring issues, surface advertiser feedback, and scale durable solutions. - Drive operational excellence through AI-assisted workflows and automation that reduce manual effort, improve team efficiency, and elevate support quality. - Support readiness for new ads formats, features, and markets by anticipating advertiser questions and identifying support risks early. - Providing occasional holiday and weekend support on call coverage, as needed, to support business and customer needs. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 6+ years of experience in customer support, user operations, ads operations, Trust & Safety, risk operations, escalations, or a related field, including ownership of high-impact customer or advertiser cases. - Bring strong investigative judgment and can translate ambiguous signals into policy support, operational gaps, product defects, and expected behavior - Can synthesize data trends, feedback, QA findings, and service metrics into clear priorities and system improvement while maintaining strong judgment and safeguards - Have improved support processes, knowledge bases, escalation workflows, routing systems, or quality programs. - Are comfortable using AI and emerging technologies (i.e. Codex, ChatGPT, OpenAI API, etc.) and/or code (e.g. Python) to automate repetitive tasks and integrating tools - Build trust with cross-functional partners, communicate clearly and empathetically with advertisers and internal teams, and drive action without formal authority. - Thrive in ambiguity, learn quickly, manage competing priorities, and bring a humble, service-oriented mindset. - Understand advertiser workflows, ads ecosystems, policy enforcement, account reviews, or ads safety operations. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Platform Security Engineering (PSE) sits within Data Center Security Engineering (DCSE). As Anthropic expands beyond traditional cloud providers into owned facilities, colocation, and partner sites, we take on the security responsibilities that cloud providers used to abstract away: firmware integrity, boot chain verification, platform trust, and host hardening. PSE exists so that Anthropic can deploy training and inference workloads to any qualified environment with a demonstrable security posture, including the technical controls behind our AI Safety Level commitments. We are hiring an engineering manager to lead a group of platform security engineers covering firmware research, OS and kernel hardening, platform trust integration, and server manageability firmware. You will own the roadmap for this group, grow the team, and be accountable for the security posture of the compute platforms Anthropic runs on: hardware roots of trust, secure and measured boot, attestation, firmware supply chain, and the integrity of the hosts that hold model weights on bare-metal infrastructure. This is a hands-on management role. You will not write most of the code, but you will review designs, make the final call on hard trade-offs, and be able to reason with your engineers from a silicon root of trust through firmware, bootloader, kernel, and host software. You will partner with infrastructure, fleet, and compute teams inside Anthropic, and with silicon vendors, OEMs, and compute providers outside it. items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is seeking a talented security-focused software engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will play a critical role in developing and maintaining the security foundation of our platform. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and testing security features across various software components. You will: Design, develop, and maintain secure software for core platform functionalities, particularly focusing on: Authentication and authorization systems Secure communication channels between services (e.g., API security) Secure data storage and access controls Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, product) to integrate security best practices throughout the development lifecycle. Stay up-to-date on the latest security threats, vulnerabilities, and mitigation strategies. Conduct security code reviews and identify potential security risks in existing codebases. Develop and implement automated security testing procedures. Respond to security incidents and participate in incident response procedures. Continuously improve the platform's security posture by identifying and implementing security enhancements. Document security processes, procedures, and best practices. About you: BA/BS in computer science, or related degree, MS a strong plus Minimum 5+ years of experience in software development with a strong focus on security aspects Proven experience in designing and implementing secure authentication and authorization systems In-depth understanding of secure coding principles and best practices (e.g., OWASP Top 10) Experience with secure communication protocols (e.g., TLS/SSL) Familiarity with security testing tools and methodologies (e.g., static code analysis, penetration testing) Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills Strong communication and collaboration skills Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team Passion for security and a commitment to building secure and reliable systems Key knowledge and skills Thrive in a customer-focused, tight-nit and cross-functional environment - being a team player and willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company is a must. A proactive and positive attitude to lead, learn, troubleshoot and take ownership of both small tasks and large features. An interest/desire to learn and own various aspects of security. Strong coding skills (for example in Go/Python/Java/C++ etc) with an emphasis on designing for reliability and scale, and writing well-tested components. Experience with cloud security principles and tools (AWS Security, GCP Security) Experience with container security (Docker Security, Kubernetes Security) Location: This role is remote Compensation & Benefits: The standard base salary range for this position is $185,000 - $260,000 annually. items.title: Director, Litigation
items.description: Perplexity AI is looking for a sharp, entrepreneurial litigation attorney to join our small legal team to help advance the business, protect the products we are building, and revolutionize the way people search and interact with the internet. This unique role offers significant responsibility, direct ownership of high stakes matters, and growth potential across an in-house practice group. This is a unique role within a rapidly growing AI technology company. You will play a key role in safeguarding Perplexity’s interests by managing litigation files and pre-litigation disputes related to our AI answer engine, models, and technologies, while helping to build and scale our litigation function. You will oversee complex disputes in a fast-moving and often unsettled legal landscape, spanning intellectual property (including copyright), privacy, commercial, and regulatory matters, and you will work closely with our AI, engineering, and product teams to assess legal risk, develop litigation strategy, and provide guidance during disputes involving our products and services. The ideal candidate combines deep substantive knowledge of litigation practice and procedure with strong business judgment and practical problem-solving abilities. You are comfortable confronting novel legal issues, including questions where the rules are still being written, and you bring intellectual curiosity about AI technology, adaptability in an emerging landscape, and exceptional collaboration skills. Success in this role requires a deep understanding of high-growth startup environments, where you will pair traditional legal expertise with sharp business risk assessment. We are seeking someone who is inquisitive, has an entrepreneurial drive, and the agility to thrive in our fast-paced environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Manage litigation matters and pre-litigation disputes across all phases, including strategy, pleadings, motions, discovery, depositions, hearings, trials, and appeals, while developing comprehensive case strategies that align with business objectives. - Provide counsel across a broad range of disputes, including intellectual property (copyright, trademark, and trade secret), privacy, commercial, and regulatory matters, in both first-party and third-party contexts. - Evaluate and respond to litigation threats, demands, and disputes across jurisdictions, developing appropriate matter-resolution proposals that resolve issues with minimal disruption to the business. - Select, onboard, manage, and collaborate with outside counsel across all stages of disputes. Negotiate budgets and fee arrangements, monitor performance, and hold outside counsel accountable for delivering optimal results while maintaining cost efficiency. - Partner closely with AI, product, and engineering teams to proactively identify litigation risks in product development and go-to-market strategies, and to collect information efficiently in support of active matters. Translate complex legal requirements into practical, actionable guidance for technical teams. - Assist in responding to regulatory investigations and inquiries from government regulators and private organizations relating to our products and services. - Build internal litigation processes, policies, and tools, including legal-hold and discovery workflows, that support litigation and regulatory matters efficiently and can scale with company growth. - Monitor the evolving legal and regulatory landscape for AI, copyright, and privacy; translate court decisions, agency guidance, and legislative developments into timely, executive-ready advice; and communicate with business leaders about ongoing litigation, emerging risks, and preventive measures. QUALIFICATIONS - JD and in good standing with an active US state bar membership (California preferred) - At least 15+ years of law firm and/or in-house experience handling complex commercial litigation (with experience representing emerging technology companies preferred) - Deep substantive knowledge of litigation practice and procedure, with a demonstrated history of strong outcomes and effective case execution - Exceptional analytical, organizational, and collaboration skills, strong business acumen, and the ability to partner with business and technical teams - An ability to communicate clearly and credibly with business and technical audiences, including translating genuinely unsettled legal doctrine into concise, business-relevant advice for executives and engineers without over-hedging - Hands-on attitude to tackle projects large and small, and a low-ego, roll-up-your-sleeves approach to working across the organization - Excellent composure in stressful situations, high level of integrity, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to work independently with limited guidance while exercising good judgment about when to escalate - Thrive working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment NICE TO HAVE - Experience managing copyright and privacy litigation, as well as commercial disputes, for AI or other emerging technology companies - Experience managing regulatory responses or investigations, including both first-party and third-party responses - Experience building or scaling a litigation function at a growth-stage company, with creativity and an openness to novel solutions - Experience litigating cases in multiple jurisdictions, including internationally - A passion for supporting the development of AI that is both innovative and trustworthy
